item.title: MLIT publishes recommendations on river-centered ecological networks
item.description: AI summary: On 2026-11-17, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT) published expert-panel recommendations on conserving and creating river-basin environments. These are policy recommendations, not an announced statutory amendment. They recommend assessing ecological connections across six categories, mapping green infrastructure and its gaps, and combining habitat conservation and creation with infrastructure and supporting measures that restore or strengthen ecological networks. The recommendations envisage shared basin-wide goals extending beyond river and administrative boundaries, with river administrators playing a central coordinating role.
